tools.name: generate_model
tools.description: Start a background Meshy generate job and return its job_id at once. Give a prompt, one to four reference images, or both. Prompt only: Meshy shapes the model from the text. With images, the images shape the model and the prompt steers only the texture. texture=False returns the untextured mesh, with no prompt and images together. pose is a-pose or t-pose and applies to characters and creatures with limbs only; set it only for those, never for props. Poll get_meshy_job(job_id) until it succeeds.

tools.name: retexture_model
tools.description: Start a background Meshy retexture job for an authored collection and return its job_id. The collection must already be in the Blender session with mesh SM_<name>. Give exactly one of prompt and image_path. The job downloads base color, normal, roughness, and metallic maps and wires them into the collection's material.

tools.name: get_meshy_job
tools.description: Return a Meshy job's state: queued, running (stage and progress), succeeded (with the GLB or map paths and any warnings), or failed (with code, message, and remediation).
